title: 2102. Converting a Lowercase Letter to Uppercase Using ASCII Arithmetic
description:
02
. 
Converting a Lowercase Letter to Uppercase Using ASCII Arithmetic
95
Hard
Problem Statement
Read a lowercase letter and convert it to uppercase using arithmetic on its ASCII value, without using any built-in case-conversion function.
Description
Read a single lowercase character. Compute and print the resulting uppercase character using arithmetic operation.
Input Description
A single lowercase letter.
Output Description
Print the corresponding uppercase letter.
Sample Input
g
Sample Output
G
